title: Compress triplets into rows

blocks.text: A water utility's model builder adds terms to its rules one at a time, as (row, column, value) triplets: row is the pumping station's rule, column the pump, value the coefficient. Before the matrix goes to the checker it is compressed into CSR form, and you write the compressor, with no SciPy.
Write `to_csr(n_rows, triplets)` in `csr.py`. It returns three lists, `(indptr, indices, data)`:

items: `data`: the values, row 0 first, then row 1, and so on; within a row, by increasing column;
`indices`: the column of each value in `data`;
`indptr`: `n_rows + 1` entries; row $`i`$'s values are `data[indptr[i]:indptr[i + 1]]`, so `indptr[0]` is 0 and the last entry is `len(data)`.

blocks.text: The triplets may arrive in any order. A row may have no triplets at all, including the last rows. When two triplets name the same row and column, the builder meant their sum: store one entry with the two values added.

import logging

# Turn the logger up, so the `log.debug` lines of your code show under the printed lines.
logging.basicConfig(level=logging.DEBUG, format="%(levelname)s %(message)s")

from csr import to_csr

# Rows are depots, columns are trucks; one entry is given twice, row 1 is empty.
triplets = [(2, 1, 5), (0, 3, 2), (0, 0, 7), (2, 1, 1), (3, 2, 4)]
indptr, indices, data = to_csr(4, triplets)
print("indptr:", indptr)
print("indices:", indices)
print("data:", data)

from __future__ import annotations


def to_csr(n_rows: int, triplets: list[tuple[int, int, float]]) -> tuple[list[int], list[int], list[float]]:
    """CSR arrays (indptr, indices, data) of an n_rows-row matrix given as (row, col, value) triplets."""
    # TODO: group the triplets by row, sort each row by column, and record where each row ends.
    return [0] * (n_rows + 1), [], []


if __name__ == "__main__":
    print(to_csr(2, [(0, 1, 5), (1, 0, 2), (0, 0, 3)]))

cases.says: triplets already sorted by row and column become the three CSR arrays
triplets that arrive in any order come out sorted by row, then by column
a row with no entries in the middle gives two equal neighbours in indptr
rows with no entries after the last nonzero still get their indptr entries
two triplets for the same row and column are added into one entry

origin.section: Store Only the Nonzeros: Triplets, Then Compressed Rows

concepts: CSR keeps values row by row, sorted by column, with indptr marking where each row ends, empty rows included and repeated entries added
